ex.en: The speech was full of empty rhetoric.
ex.zh: 這場演講充滿空洞的言辭。

ex.en: Voters are tired of political rhetoric.
ex.zh: 選民已經厭倦了政治口水。
這是一種舒緩的東方節奏。

ex.en: I can't dance because I have no sense of rhythm.
ex.zh: 我不會跳舞，因為我沒有節奏感。

ex.en: Shift work can upset your body's natural rhythm.
ex.zh: 輪班工作可能打亂身體的自然規律。

ex.en: It took me a week to get into the rhythm of my new job.
ex.zh: 我花了一週才適應新工作的步調。
